# GRAPH_EXPAND joins the documented StoreGraph from its root, Stores, to Locations. Sometown,
# which no store references, drops out of the LEFT JOIN, and the inlined edge SL adds no columns.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-sql-queries.md
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(t) FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreGraph') AS t WHERE S_name = 'Store 1'
=> "{\"S_location_id\":101,\"S_name\":\"Store 1\",\"L_id\":101,\"L_name\":\"Anytown\",\"L_population\":1000}"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreGraph')
=> "2"
SELECT SUM(L_population) FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreGraph') GROUP BY S_location_id
=> "2000"

# start_node expands the subgraph reachable from that node table.
SELECT STRING_AGG(L_name ORDER BY L_id) FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreGraph', start_node => 'L')
=> "Anytown,Sometown"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreLocations', start_node => 'S')
=> "2"

# Graphs that the documented input limitations exclude: multiple root node tables without
# start_node, and a label other than the default one.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreLocations')
=> error:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.LabeledStores')
=> error:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GRAPH_EXPAND('scalar_graph.StoreGraph', start_node => 'Missing')
=> error:
